title: Slice the Prefix
goal: Slice a string reference up to a byte offset safely without panicking.
hints: Check if the offset falls on a UTF-8 character boundary before slicing.
Remember that slicing a string slice produces a borrowed view requiring `&`.
explanation: `is_char_boundary(end_byte)` verifies that the offset falls between UTF-8 characters. Calling `contains` expects a character pattern and causes compiler error E0277. Calling `is_empty()` ignores the byte index and skips valid prefixes. Using `&s[..end_byte]` returns a `&str` view. Omitting `&` produces an unsized `str` value which triggers type errors.
